      ResourceKey.Builder namespace(String namespace)
      Sets the key's namespace.

      If using a ResourceKey.MINECRAFT_NAMESPACE or ResourceKey.SPONGE_NAMESPACE, it is preferable to use ResourceKey.minecraft(String) or ResourceKey.sponge(String) instead.
